articles.title: Standard Return & Exchange Policy
articles.body: Items may be returned within 30 days of delivery in original condition for a full refund or exchange.

articles.title: Loyalty-Gold Extended Return Window
articles.body: Loyalty-Gold members get a 60-day return window instead of the standard 30 days.

articles.title: Standard Shipping Rates & Timelines
articles.body: Standard shipping is 5-7 business days. Expedited shipping (2-3 days) is available at checkout.

articles.title: Free Shipping Threshold
articles.body: Orders over $50 ship free via standard shipping.

articles.title: Product Warranty Overview
articles.body: All products carry a 1-year manufacturer warranty against defects.

articles.title: Extended Warranty for Electronics
articles.body: Electronics purchases can add a 2-year extended warranty plan at checkout.

articles.title: Legacy Loyalty Points Program (pre-2026)
articles.body: [LEGACY] Points were earned at 1 point per $1 spent, redeemable at 100 points = $5.

articles.title: Rewards+ Loyalty Program (2026)
articles.body: Rewards+ replaces the legacy points program: earn 2 points per $1, redeemable at 100 points = $6, plus tier bonuses for Gold members.

articles.title: Sizing Guide: Apparel
articles.body: Refer to the size chart on each product page; measurements are in inches and true to standard US sizing.

articles.title: Accepted Payment Methods
articles.body: We accept major credit cards, PayPal, and installment payments through our checkout partner.

articles.title: New Customer Welcome Discount
articles.body: New customers get 10% off their first order with code WELCOME10 at checkout.

articles.title: Gift Card Terms
articles.body: Gift cards do not expire and can be combined with other payment methods at checkout.

articles.title: Price Match Guarantee
articles.body: We'll match a lower price from a major competitor within 14 days of purchase.

articles.title: 2025 Holiday Shipping Deadlines
articles.body: [OUTDATED] Order by Dec 18, 2025 for standard delivery before the winter holidays.

articles.title: 2026 Holiday Shipping Deadlines
articles.body: Order by Dec 17, 2026 for standard delivery before the winter holidays.

articles.title: Store Locator & In-Store Pickup
articles.body: Use the store locator on our site to find a location offering same-day in-store pickup.
